name: WDUi Framework SDK
changes_cs: Aktualizovany WDUi Framework SDK: proprietarni binarni x64 SDK s hlavickami, wdui.lib, default skiny/fonty, binarnim demo a otevrenou ukazkou pouziti bez zdrojovych cpp souboru knihovny. Tato verze obsahuje fotorealisticky spatial material shading a prostorovejsi vychozi skiny.
changes_en: Updated WDUi Framework SDK: proprietary binary x64 SDK with headers, wdui.lib, default skins/fonts, binary demo, and an open usage example without library cpp sources. This version includes photoreal spatial material shading and more dimensional default skins.
